summary: Frontend-only QA completed on the static portfolio preview. Core navigation/interactions work, but critical WebGL visual fidelity issues were found in Work/Proof/Gallery stages.

ui_bugs.issue: Channel card faces appear as blank light-gray blocks instead of visible branded/image faces during tested scroll stages.
ID card appears as a blank light rectangle in the proof phase instead of a readable credential hold at the specified stage.
Gallery photo surfaces appear white/blank in staged 3D views (0.57/0.73/0.89) although dialog opens image correctly.
Primary red material renders salmon/orange-leaning instead of strong YouTube red under current lighting/tone mapping.

issues: Visual composition fidelity diverges from master intent when key proof/work/gallery media planes are not visibly rendered.
Red+white palette is mostly respected, but hero red hue needs material/grade correction to avoid orange cast.

action_items: Fix WebGL media-surface rendering/orientation/material mapping so channel cards, ID card, and gallery photos are visibly textured in-scene (not only in dialogs).
Tune hero red material and post-lighting/tone-mapping to match required genuine YouTube red (reduce salmon/orange cast).
Re-run full multi-viewport visual QA (390 and 320 especially) after rendering fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: script.js uses preserveDrawingBuffer: true on WebGLRenderer, which likely contributes to repeated GPU stall (ReadPixels) warnings and avoidable render cost.
Console warns deprecated Three.js build usage (build/three.min.js); while functional, future compatibility risk should be tracked.
Data-testid coverage/uniqueness is good (63 unique ids, no duplicates).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core controls passed: Home/Work/Proofs/Contact nav, Explore Work, enter scroll button, back-to-top, mobile menu open-close/escape/tab, motion toggle, OS reduced motion, dialog open/close for credential and photos, contact links, no /api calls, no broken images. Primary blocker is in-scene WebGL media visibility/fidelity (blank card/photo surfaces).
rca of the issue: RCA hypothesis from reproducible screenshots across desktop and mobile: non-hero media planes (channel cards, ID, gallery photos) are rendered but appear blank, suggesting texture-face orientation/material-side/camera-facing mismatch or texture pipeline issue specific to in-scene meshes. Since modal image viewer shows correct assets, source files are present; issue is likely in 3D mesh display path (pose/rotation/face side/render settings) rather than missing files.
